name: Main Building
shortDescription: The heart of the campus with the office, staff room and clock tower.
detailedDescription: The Main Building is the oldest and most recognisable building on campus, crowned by its clock tower. It houses the principal's office, the administration office and the staff room, and its corridors connect to the classroom wing.
